title: The Spell's Gift
prompt: The spell adds two numbers perfectly and gives back nothing at all. One word is missing.

line_hints.0: The spell is declared correctly and takes both reagents it needs.
line_hints.3: Calling and printing is right. The spell really does run — it just comes back empty-handed.

fixes.why: The sum was computed and then dropped on the floor. `return` is what carries a value back out of the spell; without it every function hands back None.
You would SEE 5 — then None underneath it. Printing shows a value to the room; returning gives it to the caller. Only one of those can be stored in a variable.
That changes a name that dies the moment the spell ends. Nothing leaves the room, and the caller still gets None.

config.success: Printing speaks. Returning gives. Only what is given can be caught and used again.
